title: Bowl Won't Rotate
fullDescription: Ankarsrum's spinning bowl is driven by a friction roller. If bowl doesn't turn, roller may need cleaning or pressure adjustment.

fixSteps.title: Clean roller
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe drive roller and bowl base with alcohol.

title: Thermal Shutdown
fullDescription: Ankarsrum thermal protection triggers after very long heavy doughs. Cool 30 minutes.

title: Drive Belt Slipping
fullDescription: Drive belt loose or worn. Symptom: high-pitched whine, weak power.

title: Dough Climbing Roller
fullDescription: Wet doughs climb up the dough roller. Adjust position or scraper.

fixSteps.title: Adjust roller
fixSteps.instruction: Move dough roller to outer position.

title: Bowl Wobbling
fullDescription: Bowl pin not seated or worn. Lift and reseat onto drive pin.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Lift bowl and place onto center pin.

faq.a: Bowl mounts via center pin and rim.

title: Won't Start
fullDescription: No power despite outlet working. Likely interlock not engaged.

fixSteps.title: Check arm
fixSteps.instruction: Lower roller arm fully — interlock activates motor.

title: Unusual Noise
fullDescription: Bearing wear or attachment loose. Inspect and lubricate.

title: Roller Won't Remove
fullDescription: Drive roller seized to drive shaft, often from dough buildup.

fixSteps.title: Soak
fixSteps.instruction: Wrap with damp cloth 15 min, twist gently.

title: Speed Knob Unresponsive
fullDescription: Speed potentiometer dirty or failing.

fixSteps.title: Service required
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Ankarsrum service for control repair.

title: Oil Seepage
fullDescription: Some oil weeping from gearbox after extended use is normal; excessive needs service.

title: Roller wobble
fullDescription: Bowl roller wobble. Common indication on Ankarsrum stand mixer.

fixSteps.title: Test cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Run a normal cycle to verify.

whenToCallPro: If reset and cleaning don't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most issues are sensor/contact related — cleaning often fixes.
